rules.name: Stripe Secret API Key
rules.remediation: Move Stripe secret keys to environment variables or secret store. Never commit live or test credentials.

rules.name: GitHub Personal Access Token
rules.remediation: Revoke the exposed GitHub token immediately and use fine-grained GitHub Actions secrets or environment variables.

rules.name: Google / Gemini API Key
rules.remediation: Extract the Google API key into GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable and add to .env (ensuring .env is gitignored).

rules.name: OpenAI API Key
rules.remediation: Rotate and configure OpenAI credentials via OPENAI_API_KEY in process environment.

rules.name: AWS Access Key ID
rules.remediation: Rotate AWS access key pair immediately; use AWS IAM roles or temporary STS credentials.

rules.name: Private Cryptographic Key
rules.remediation: Never commit private cryptographic key blocks into source code repositories.

rules.name: Unparameterized SQL Injection Concatenation
rules.remediation: Replace string concatenation with parameterized SQL bindings ($1, ?) or an approved ORM query builder.
